reviews.text: I first came to these classes having never tried parkour and I’m so glad I took the leap! The environment is so welcoming and friendly, and it’s really nice how everyone encourages each other in their own personal achievements. Andy is an excellent coach, very knowledgeable and patient, and great at finding the right challenge for anyone whatever their level. The classes are really well thought out and a great mix of physical challenges, mental exercises, strength, skills, and a lot of fun. I am amazed by how far I have come and the ways I have been able to push my comfort zone and improve my fitness and the ways that I move. 100% recommend for anyone who is curious or wants to find out what their body can do!

reviews.author: Mateusz Wacławek
reviews.location_label: Canada Water Tube station, Surrey Quays Road, London SE16 2YS
reviews.text:
Why would you want to try Parkour?
- to enjoy outdoors and explore the city's hidden locations,
- to develop not only all body's muscles but also unique movement skills. For example today I had a solo training in a park. And a father with kids saw my superior skills and asked me if I could climb up on a construction to bring stuck balls down. It wasn't as satisfying as rescuing a princess from a burning castle. But still it felt cool to be able to do it :D ,
- to meet super friendly and unique people that will become your community. There is no more supportive and encouraging sport than Parkour is.

Now, the trainer. Andy Pearson is very experienced and super friendly. He will challenge you in a gentle way so that each class you will push your fear and physical barrier a little bit further. And I found that its extremely fulfilling when you do something you thought you couldn't.

You will also become more confident. If something unpleasant happens to you. Like a bad comment or feedback from a boss. You will be like..."meh, when I hit my shin on that wall we tried to jump over. That hurt way more that this".

I hope I will see you there!
Matt
reviews.quote: There is no more supportive and encouraging sport than Parkour is.

reviews.author: Alex Green
reviews.location_label: Canada Water Tube station, Surrey Quays Road, London SE16 2YS
reviews.text: If you're thinking of trying a new sport or challenging yourself fitness-wise, I can’t recommend London Parkour enough!! What I love about the classes is that they’re individualised for people of all skill levels. Already a seasoned ninja warrior (like my husband)? You will be put to the test. Newbie (like me)? The instructors make you feel safe and supported but definitely help you push yourself out of your comfort zone (or in my case take tiny baby steps out of my comfort zone while literally holding their hand sometimes!) until you are doing things you NEVER thought you’d be able to do. You will learn so much about how your body moves and what you’re capable of, and there's such a fun social atmosphere with a lot of fist-bumps and mutual encouragement. The instructors are extremely knowledgeable and dedicated to helping you push the boundaries of your fitness and agility creatively and safely, while having a really fun time and burning about a billion calories per hour. Just go for it.
reviews.quote: If you're thinking of trying a new sport or challenging yourself fitness-wise, I can’t recommend London Parkour enough!!

My son has been attending youth classes at Vauxhall for a couple of years now. The classes have been great both for physical and mental self-development. He has progressed from an athletic but very shy individual into a much more self-confident and emotionally resilient tween. Parkour teaches kids the invaluable life skill of how to approach and overcome challenges, and it is not all about out-competing your peers like some sports.
A lot of the success of the group is down to the instructor Kie. He is amazing with the kids and an excellent mentor and role model. He can tailor the classes so that each child feels adequately challenged in order to reap the rewards. I’m so glad we found the group and highly recommend for anyone who has kids.
reviews.quote: He has progressed from an athletic but very shy individual into a much more self-confident and emotionally resilient tween.

reviews.text: These parkour sessions have been part of a huge transformation for our son. He experienced a number of health challenges a year ago and has got through these with a lot of hard work and positivity, but the one thing he’s always wanted to do is parkour. So when we found this group, and an expert teacher, that was prepared to not only see physical environments as a parkour challenge, but teach Ethan how this mentality can support him further through life challenges too, we were over the moon! We have great communication each week with the teacher about what the group of kids accomplished in their sessions and we receive lots of videos and pictures later that day which are the highlight of our Sunday afternoons. Sessions take place rain or shine, and even in the snow, teaching children safe movement in all conditions as well as an enjoyment for seasons, the urban and natural environment and a love of London! For us, this has been incredibly rewarding. Thanks Kie and everyone at London parkour!

Andy is a very skilled athlete and coach.  In just one 1:1 session he managed to change my 12-year-old son's freerunning focus away from jumping off high things dangerously, to a more considered approach of being specific and exact in his interactions with railings etc and landings from jumps.
Andy is really encouraging and gave him lots of different ideas to try. We have now had two sessions and my super-energetic son is shattered!  He is also buzzing with all he has learnt and wants to try once his body stops aching!
At times it is hard to watch my boy in the session jumping between walls, or climbing on various things, but I feel strongly that he is in very safe hands with Andy.
